Rendering pipelines

While a teammate created the project, I checked what recommend rendering pipeline would be best for the project.

While a teamate created the project I checked what recommed rendering pipelienw would be best for the project. Since the brief for the game jam expsiitliy said that it should be a html build primiarly, the underivasl render pipeline worked best for the needs12.

Web

Since one of the criteria was looking into having it build for html it was important to make sure there wasn’t any performance issues once built. This was something I communicated early to the team and looked throughout the production of the game. This included daily check ups of performance. … Automating would’ve been better.

https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/webgl-performance.html - This was read to make sure that the web port wouldn’t have problems and any concerns to look out for

https://unity.com/how-to/profile-optimize-web-build#responsive-design - This goes over more optimisation details

https://learn.unity.com/tutorial/getting-started-with-unity-web - This goes over how to build for web from unity.
